summary: Regression pass for Expo SDK 54->57 upgrade (RN 0.86.3, React 19.2.3, reanimated 4.5.1, gesture-handler 2.32, screens 4.26, worklets 0.10.1, expo-camera/location/etc bumped). App loads with ZERO console/page errors across all tested screens: landing, login, Explore Demo login, Today dashboard, Radar (map render + zoom-in/out + recentre buttons via gesture-handler/reanimated), Nearby, Encounters, Profile, Photo Verification screen, Location Privacy screen, Meetup Point flow, Business Demo login + dashboard. expo-doctor reports 20/20 checks passed. Backend regression 27/28 (96%) pass -- backend is Python/FastAPI, completely unaffected by this frontend-only SDK bump; the 1 failure is a pre-existing data-state-dependent test unrelated to the upgrade. IMPORTANT FINDING: contrary to the agent-to-agent note claiming 'no new lint errors', re-running `npx eslint app/ src/` now shows 104 NEW errors (previously would have been 0/pre-existing-warnings-only) from eslint-plugin-react-hooks v7.1.1 (bundled via eslint-config-expo 10.0.0 -> ~57.0.2), which ships new React-Compiler-based lint rules not present before this upgrade: react-hooks/set-state-in-effect (56), react-hooks/refs (28), react-hooks/static-components (10), react-hooks/immutability (6), react-hooks/purity (3). These are lint-only findings (no runtime crashes observed anywhere), but they ARE a direct regression of the SDK/eslint-config-expo bump and should be reported/tracked, not dismissed as pre-existing.

minor.issue: test_verified_sana_sees_requests failed (expected >=1 pending request, got 0) -- data-state dependent (likely consumed by earlier accept/decline in seeded flow), unrelated to Expo SDK upgrade since backend code was not touched.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_CONTROL_BACKEND_URL (https://nearby-connect-93.emergent.host) which is a DIFFERENT host than EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (preview env). QA admin credentials from test_credentials.md return 401 on that host (confirmed via direct curl to that host, vs 200 on the preview host with same credentials). This is a pre-existing environment/config separation between preview and 'emergent.host' deployments, NOT caused by the SDK upgrade -- flagging for awareness since Control Centre could not be fully regression-tested end-to-end in this environment.

eslint_new_regressions.root_cause: eslint-config-expo bumped 10.0.0 -> ~57.0.2 as part of this Expo SDK 57 upgrade, which pulls in eslint-plugin-react-hooks v7.1.1 (React Compiler-era rules). These rules did not exist/run before this upgrade.
eslint_new_regressions.impact: Lint-only, no observed runtime crashes in any tested screen/flow. Will fail any CI/lint gate that requires zero errors. Contradicts the claim in the review request that eslint showed 'only pre-existing warnings unrelated to this upgrade' -- that check must have been run before/without these new plugin versions actually installed, or before this file set was linted with the new config.

action_items: Fix or re-triage the 104 new eslint errors introduced by eslint-plugin-react-hooks v7.1.1 (via eslint-config-expo 57 bump) -- primarily react-hooks/set-state-in-effect across many hooks/screens (e.g. src/control/RadarPanel.tsx:43, src/control/Shell.tsx:55, src/control/VerificationQueue.tsx:33, and dozens more). These are new React-Compiler-oriented lint rules, not functional bugs, but should be addressed or the rules explicitly downgraded/disabled if not desired, so CI lint gates don't silently start failing post-upgrade.
No functional/runtime regressions found across any tested screen or flow -- SDK 57 upgrade itself appears clean at runtime.

Control Centre could not be fully regression-tested end-to-end in this preview environment because it targets a separate backend host (EXPO_PUBLIC_CONTROL_BACKEND_URL) that returned 401 for the documented QA credentials -- this is a pre-existing environment separation, not an upgrade regression, but worth a quick sanity check by main agent if Control Centre regression coverage is needed.

Re-run tests/test_iter19_adaptive_radar.py::TestProRequestsGate::test_verified_sana_sees_requests in isolation (not full suite) to confirm it's a test-ordering/data-state flake rather than a real issue -- did not investigate further since backend code is untouched by this upgrade and out of scope for a pure SDK regression pass.
critical_code_review_comments: RadarView.tsx remains ~1239 lines (previously flagged in iteration_90) -- still exceeds the 700-line guideline; unrelated to this upgrade but worth eventual refactor.

The 104 new eslint-plugin-react-hooks errors are legitimate code-quality flags surfaced by the newer rule set (e.g. calling setState directly in useEffect bodies) -- while not causing runtime issues in this app (React 19's automatic batching / lack of StrictMode double-invoke in this test run masked them), they represent real anti-patterns the new compiler-aware linter is designed to catch and could cause issues under React Compiler/concurrent features in the future.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable regression flows passed with zero runtime console/page errors

seed_data_creation: None -- reused existing seeded demo data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Expo SDK 57 upgrade is functionally clean -- zero runtime crashes/console errors across landing, login, Today, Radar (incl. zoom/recentre gesture-handler+reanimated interactions), Nearby, Encounters, Profile, Photo Verification, Location Privacy, Meetup Point, and Business Demo dashboard. The ONE real finding from this session is that eslint-config-expo's bump (10.0.0 -> 57.0.2) pulled in eslint-plugin-react-hooks v7.1.1 which introduces 104 NEW lint errors (set-state-in-effect/refs/static-components/immutability/purity) across the codebase that did not exist under the old config -- main agent should decide whether to fix these or adjust lint config, since the original problem statement's claim of 'only pre-existing lint warnings' does not hold up under a fresh eslint run with the new package versions actually installed.
rca_of_issue: New eslint errors RCA: eslint-config-expo went from major version 10.0.0 to 57.0.2 as part of the Expo SDK 57 upgrade. This package transitively bumped eslint-plugin-react-hooks to v7.1.1, which ships React-Compiler-era rules (set-state-in-effect, refs, static-components, immutability, purity) that are stricter than the previous rule set and were not evaluated before. No code changes were made to trigger this -- it's purely the new lint ruleset catching pre-existing patterns (e.g. calling setState synchronously inside useEffect) that the old eslint-plugin-react-hooks version did not flag. Not a runtime bug; purely a static-analysis/lint-config side effect of the dependency bump.
